items.name: member-picker
items.title: Member picker
items.description: Pick a member of your org: a members-only GET /api/members route, backed by list_org_members, and a searchable list to choose from.
items.docs: Add the route to `api` in server/app.ts: import { orgMembersRoute } from "./org-members.ts", then "GET /api/members": orgMembersRoute(botpage). In the UI: const members = useOrgMembers() (from @/lib/org-members), then <MemberPicker members={members} value={userId} onChange={setUserId} />. Every org member who can open the app sees every member's name, email and role; drop email in src/lib/org-members-contract.ts if you don't need it. Members are identified by the Bot Page proxy, so the app must be reached only through it (the template listens on 127.0.0.1). The list is cached: someone removed from the org can still read it for up to 60 s, or about 6 minutes while the platform is unreachable.

items.name: approval-flow
items.title: Approval flow
items.description: Ask a member of your org to approve something; they approve or reject it with a note, and everyone in the org sees each request and its history.
items.docs: Setup: in server/app.ts add `tools: ToolCaller` (from @botyard/runtime) to AppOptions; pass `tools: runtime` where server/index.ts calls createApp, and `tools: mockRuntime()` in test/helpers.ts. Add to `api`: ...approvalRoutes({ botpage, tools, store: new ApprovalStore(path.join(appRoot, "data", "approvals.json")) }) (approvalRoutes and ApprovalStore from ./approvals.ts, appRoot from ./config.ts), and the member picker's "GET /api/members": orgMembersRoute(botpage). Add data/ to .gitignore. In the UI: <ApprovalFlow />. Who sees what: every org member sees every request, its details and its history; only the chosen approver decides. Limits: run ONE app process per data file: each process keeps its own copy and rewrites the whole file, so two would overwrite each other's changes. Each change is flushed to disk before it is answered; if that cannot be confirmed, the answer says durable: false and the UI warns not to send it again. new ApprovalStore(null) keeps requests in memory only, so every answer is durable: false. Each change re-checks membership with a fresh list_org_members listing: a recent snapshot, not a lock. The JSON-only API keeps other sites' forms out as long as the Bot Page proxy does not allow credentialed cross-origin requests. For many requests or several processes, move the store to a database.
